integrity: Proof-backed infinite parameter statement and separately replayable finite exhaustive testing; no claim of independently verified novelty or authorship.
scientific_limitations: Once-subdivided complete graphs n>=3; unweighted distances and single-edge failure model. Computational checks through n=6 only. The 2025 paper on subdivision-graph distance monitoring was not available in full; prior coverage remains a material originality risk.
title: Complete distance-edge-monitoring and minimal-probe enumerators for subdivided cliques
